context: Output rose to 64 from 62 across five completed cycles, the best in the recent window, at 1330s per cycle (selector 258s, writer 360s, editor 126s). No experiment has run since May; the standing reason remains that the residual problems — region tagging and category taxonomy — lie outside the tunable parameter surface, so the slot is left unspent rather than filled with a change that could not reach them.
